Recap

🎆 We Marched in Marysville!

Union County Democrats showed up and showed out in this year's Marysville 4th of July Parade — celebrating America's 250th birthday the right way, by reminding our neighbors what Democrats have delivered for this country. Social Security. Medicare. The Voting Rights Act. The Civil Rights Act. The ADA. And so much more.

Our float made a statement, and our presence on the street made an impression. This is exactly the kind of community visibility that builds momentum heading into November.

Union County Dems at the Marysville 4th of July Parade, 2026

🙌 Thank You, Volunteers! Big thanks to everyone who made this happen: Bob, John, Bryan, Cliff, Kim, Kent, and Tenah. Your time and energy are what keep this party moving forward.
Upcoming Events

📅 Mark Your Calendar

Saturday, August 1, 2026

ODP "Ohio on the Rise" Annual State Dinner — Sold Out

The Ohio Democratic Party's annual dinner is sold out — but don't count yourself out just yet! U.S. Senator Mark Kelly (D-AZ) headlines alongside Sherrod Brown and Dr. Amy Acton, plus Democratic leaders from across Ohio.

Several neighboring county parties purchased full tables. If you're interested in attending, reach out to your contacts at nearby county Democratic parties to ask about open seats — it's worth a call!

News & Updates

📣 What's Happening

🏠 HQ Update: Almost There!

Our Union County Democratic Party headquarters at 106 S Main Street in Marysville is coming together — we've hit a few bumps along the way (what grand opening doesn't?), but we are on track and getting closer every day. A grand opening is coming soon, and when it does, it'll be worth the wait.

We need volunteers to help staff the HQ once we're open. Availability is wide open right now, and a SignUpGenius link will be coming shortly — keep an eye on your inbox. This is a great way to be a visible, consistent presence for the party in our community.
